title: Mega Sol (Ability)
text:
Mega Sol (Japanese: メガソーラー Mega Solar) is an Ability introduced during Generation IX, in Pokémon Champions. It is the signature Ability of Mega Meganium.

=== In battle ===
Mega Sol causes all moves used by the Pokémon with this Ability to behave as though the weather is harsh sunlight, regardless of the actual weather on the field. When used by a Pokémon with this Ability:

Solar Beam and Solar Blade are executed in a single turn, instead of requiring a turn to charge, and do not have their power halved when used under rain, sandstorm, or snow.
Growth boosts the Pokémon's Attack and Special Attack by two stages each.
Weather Ball is a Fire-type move with a base power of 100.
Synthesis, Moonlight, and Morning Sun restore ⅔ of the Pokémon's maximum HP.
Thunder and Hurricane have their accuracy reduced to 50%.
Fire-type moves have their power increased by 50%, and Water-type moves (except for Hydro Steam, which receives the same power boost as Fire-type moves unless the user is holding a Utility Umbrella) used by the Pokémon have their power decreased by 50%.
All moves ignore the Special Defense boost granted to Rock-type Pokémon during a sandstorm and the Defense boost granted to Ice-type Pokémon during snow.
All moves ignore any accuracy-reduction effects caused by Pokémon with the Abilities Sand Veil and Snow Cloak.
Because Mega Sol does not alter the weather itself, it is unaffected by the weather-negating effect of Cloud Nine.

== Trivia ==
 
Prior to its introduction in Pokémon Champions, Mega Sol was first referenced in Meganium's Pokédex entry from Pokémon Legends: Z-A, despite the absence of Abilities. The entry mentioned "Mega Sol Cannon", referring to a "tremendously powerful" Solar Beam used by Mega Meganium. The Ability's implementation was designed by Masaaki Hoshino and inspired by text from the game's official website.
In addition to this, the moves affected by Mega Sol act similarly to how they would act as Plus Moves in Pokémon Legends: Z-A, such as the aforementioned Solar Beam.
Formerly, Growth would do nothing when used by a Pokémon with Mega Sol if the weather wasn't harsh sunlight. This has since been rectified.
